title: Build a complete revision-bound content inventory and evidence ledger
task: Implement a deterministic read-only inventory of every EN/UK page, route, section, type, source revision and counterpart. Keep structural observations separate from review/source/lab/deployment evidence. Detect added pages and stale receipts; never populate passed states from file presence or headings.
evidence: Baseline has 1,639 Markdown/MDX files and 828 EN module files; current heuristic scores saturate at 5/5. Existing runtime state is not to be rewritten by this tool.
acceptance: Inventory every current Markdown/MDX page with stable path and content digest; identify EN/UK counterpart and orphan paths.
Define retain/revise/expand/unreviewed dispositions with reviewer, revision and evidence references; missing evidence remains unreviewed.
Tests cover changed content invalidating evidence, new/missing pages, headings that do not imply review and read-only behavior.
Document commands and a complete baseline report without committing runtime-generated state.

title: Align factual, editorial, workload and completion standards across writer/reviewer tooling
task: Reconcile contradictory templates and completion semantics. Label heuristic structure honestly; design outcome-sensitive workload budgets rather than rewarding padding. Separate source support, editorial review, lab execution and deployment. Split policy, tooling and regression tests into distinct execution issues before editing. Reconcile the existing v2 citation-backfill seam: drafts remain unverified; final factual acceptance and publication require checked claims and source-fidelity review with sources available.
evidence: The live score function gives all 828 modules 5/5 from length and structural bonuses; the verifier defaults to 5,000 body words. Neither proves learning quality.
acceptance: Enumerate current writer/reviewer/rubric conflicts with exact source locations and reviewed dispositions.
Adopt a single evidence-backed definition of done without claiming heuristic checks are human/source review.
Any word-budget or gate change has explicit rationale, adversarial review and behavior tests; existing gates remain until replacement is approved.
No compulsory fictional hooks, discovery games, fact quotas or fabricated evidence in authoring prompts.
No v2 draft is promoted to final factual acceptance or publication before claim verification; earlier editorial review is provisional until source-fidelity review.

title: Verify factual claims and source support across all curriculum pages
task: Audit all curriculum portfolios, hubs and shared pages for material claims and quotations. Create section-sized source-check packets; repair unsupported or stale claims through reviewed changes. Book verification is owned by B02 and translation fidelity by L01/#1911, avoiding duplicate edits.
evidence: Presence of a Sources heading or reachable URL does not prove that the source supports a claim. Exact claim support is not established by the initial audit.
acceptance: Record claim text/location, source URL/document and locator, checked date, version/time scope, support verdict and reviewer.
Verify changing facts against official versioned documentation; use original research for technical results and appropriate independent corroboration for historical assertions.
Qualify or correct unsupported/disputed claims; no invented citations, quotations, incidents or metrics.
Every curriculum page has an explicit source-review disposition tied to its reviewed digest.

title: Establish reproducible lab validation and receipts for every practical route

evidence: Sampled VPC lab lacks a minimal traffic test; several Kubernetes/Linux exercises reveal the cause or exercise only working commands. The initial review did not execute labs.
acceptance: Map practical outcomes to setup, task, observed success/failure, verification and cleanup.
Record commands, versions, environment, timestamp and exit/output evidence; expected output alone cannot count as execution.
Provide reproducible reset/cleanup and identify billable prerequisites before creation.
Unavailable environment or provider validation remains explicitly incomplete, with a separate local alternative if useful.

Record every page's reviewed disposition; no invented learner observations or claimed statistical benefit.
